[Brooklyn](https://www.renthop.com/nyc/brooklyn-apartments) is a popular borough for renters who seek large units, amenities, and proximity to hot spots across the city. Renters can consider Brooklyn listings in November of 2026 under $3,986 and find neighborhoods with unique communities with units below[Manhattan’s](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/manhattan-new-york-ny) pricing.


The average rent for a[New York City apartment](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) this month has decreased back to[$4,900](https://www.renthop.com/average-rent-in/new-york-ny) . Now that we in the fall season, renters must still stay extra vigilant if they want to find a cost-effective apartment. Due to the declining number of options this time of year. The following Brooklyn listings in November of 2026 under $3,986 offer private balconies, in-unit washer and dryer, fitness centers, and more.

## Methodology


Released on a monthly basis, the RentHop Best Deal series aims to provide renters with useful market insights and a chance to identify rental gems currently available on the market. These listings are hand-selected by the team at[RentHop](https://www.renthop.com/apartments-for-rent/new-york-ny) based on a few factors, including layout, apartment size, features, and, more importantly, price.


Note that, given the fast-paced nature of the rental market in New York, certain Brooklyn listings may receive applications and be taken off the market within days.
